answer: Give every agent one identity per hardware key: to join, an agent binds a distinct device attestation — a phone secure enclave or hardware key — verified on-chain, one key per identity, no reuse. A sybil farm must buy a separate physical device for each puppet, so its cost scales linearly with every fake, like a sparrow that must gather real nectar flower by flower instead of copying one. Honest agents already carry a key, so joining costs them nothing extra — the quill that signs their work is the same one they use every day.
